01 / INDUSTRY APPLICATION
MANUFACTURING

A clearer view of the production floor.

Equipment conditions are difficult to see across disconnected production systems.

Bring sensor signals, equipment monitoring, and intelligent alerts into a connected operational view.

Equipment monitoringCondition alertsOperational visibility

Potential applicationMonitor a production asset and notify the responsible team when a condition needs review.

Connect
Selected machine signals, sensors, gateways, and available production-system interfaces.
Make visible
Asset condition, operational events, and the exceptions that require a person to review them.
Coordinate action
Assign alerts, create an agreed maintenance handoff, and record the resolution.
Validate first
Check signal quality, equipment compatibility, network coverage, and the usefulness of alerts at a pilot asset.

02 / INDUSTRY APPLICATION
LOGISTICS

Keep the operation connected.

Operational updates live across separate tools, teams, and locations.

Connect tracking information, exception notifications, and the systems that coordinate daily operations.

Connected trackingException workflowsSystem integration

Potential applicationRoute a shipment exception into a shared workflow so teams can track ownership and resolution.

Connect
Available shipment, tracking, warehouse, and business-platform data sources.
Make visible
Shipment status, milestones, ownership, and relevant operational exceptions.
Coordinate action
Route a delay or missing update to the responsible team and communicate agreed status changes.
Validate first
Confirm source-data freshness, tracking availability, identifiers, and integration permissions.

03 / INDUSTRY APPLICATION
SMART FACILITIES

Buildings that work together.

Independent building systems make it difficult to understand the complete picture.

Centralize selected sensor readings, facility dashboards, and automated operational workflows.

Sensor integrationFacility dashboardsAutomated alerts

Potential applicationNotify a facilities team when an environmental sensor moves outside a configured range.

Connect
Selected environmental sensors, equipment states, gateways, and permitted building-system interfaces.
Make visible
Relevant conditions across locations and the context needed to review an exception.
Coordinate action

Validate first

RETAIL

Connect the moving parts of retail.

Inventory and business processes are spread across disconnected platforms.

Connect inventory information, operational reporting, and the workflows that keep teams aligned.

Inventory workflowsConnected reportingBusiness automation

START WITH A REPRESENTATIVE PILOT

Real conditions.
A useful first test.

A connected solution needs to fit the environment it serves. A pilot should represent the devices, people, data, and exceptions the wider operation will face.

Discuss your operation
01Operating environment
Sites, equipment, network access, installation constraints, and the interfaces available.
02Useful information
The signals or records needed, their quality and freshness, and who is allowed to use them.
03A decision that matters
The alert, action, approval, or review that should follow the information.
04A meaningful review
Acceptance criteria, responsibilities, and the evidence needed before expanding the solution.
QUESTIONS & ANSWERS

From interest to a clear next step.

Clear answers help define the right next step. Your project scope and responsibilities are agreed before delivery.

Ask the team

They are potential applications for discussion. They illustrate how connected systems could support a specific operation; they are not presented as customer results or delivery claims.

The discovery work considers equipment, users, network conditions, systems, access, and operational responsibilities. The implementation depends on that environment.

A focused asset, workflow, or site can be a sensible pilot. Acceptance criteria should establish what must be learned before expansion is considered.

The operating question comes first. We identify the signals and records needed to support that question, then agree quality, access, retention, and review needs.
